<a id="data"></a>

## 📦 Use the data

| Format | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [JSON](data/accounts.json) | Complete canonical English data, categories, source URLs, and review dates |
| [CSV](data/accounts.csv) | Spreadsheet-friendly catalog with descriptions in this language |
| [TXT](data/handles.txt) | One handle per line, for search and manually building lists |
| [Sources](docs/sources.md) | Per-account evidence and review methods |
| [Candidate](docs/research-backlog.md) | Research leads excluded from the published account count |

Exports are generated from shared data. The handle list is not an official X import format; this project does not automate following.

## 🤝 Help maintain the directory

[Suggest an account](https://github.com/everclear077/awesome-ai-x-accounts/issues/new?template=account.yml) or [report a correction/removal](https://github.com/everclear077/awesome-ai-x-accounts/issues/new?template=correction.yml). Read the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md), [maintenance guide](docs/maintenance.md), and [AI workflow](docs/ai-workflow.md).

[Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) · [Help](SUPPORT.md) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

<details>
<summary>Build and verify</summary>

Python 3.11+, standard library only. Edit canonical data, locale resources, or templates, then run:

```sh
python scripts/catalog.py build
python scripts/catalog.py check
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
git diff --check
```

</details>
